title: The Black Hand of the Sabbat
summary: The Sabbat's secretive elite of warriors and strategists.

claims.text: Members of the Black Hand see the order as a Gehenna cult, a thin light holding out against the dark, though the Camarilla says the same of the whole Sabbat.
Outside the Hand, few Sabbat know much about it, and that mystery only adds to its fearsome name.
The Code of Milan requires all Sabbat to support the Black Hand.
The Hand first kept quiet and was valued for stealth and political advice, then let its skill at strategy and military training become known.

title: Black Hand Ranks and Marks
summary: Titles and signs used inside the Black Hand.

claims.text: Mustajib, deserving ones, are newly initiated members of the Hand.
A Watch Commander leads all Hand members in a territory, watches local Sabbat politics and makes sure they share the Vaulderie with each other as well as with their packs.
The crescent tattoo of the Hand has been in use since at least about 1550.

title: The Sabbat Civil Wars
summary: Long infighting that forced the Sabbat to organize.

claims.text: Internal wars have filled most of Sabbat history, and the one benefit was that they pushed the sect into firmer organization.
Gorchist's claim to the regency went unchallenged, but from far away it meant little to most members.

title: Assamite Antitribu in the Hand
summary: The Assamite antitribu and their former grip on the Hand.

claims.text: The Assamite antitribu kept their clan identity and their own circles within the Hand.
Until recently they held half the seats on the council of Seraphim and a third or more of the dominion posts, which bred resentment among other members.

title: Piotr Andreikov
summary: A Black Hand emissary code-named Winter.

claims.text: Piotr Andreikov, code name Winter, is a Black Hand emissary.
Andreikov, born in America to Ukrainian immigrants, grew up an outsider in Houston schools.

title: The School of Night
summary: An Elizabethan circle of scholars that drew Kindred interest.

claims.text: Dee, Raleigh, Marlowe, Bacon, Hariot and others were rumoured to form the School of Night, with interests from the occult and poetry to cryptography and the New World.
A Nosferatu took an interest in the circle and sought its writings rather than Embracing such famous men.
